source: Stage 1 human grades (navid) joined to frozen pool tokens by (huntId, position).
method: Pool files give token per position; grades files give position-ordered grade lists. Sections marked «باطل» excluded (Batch 4 H35-H39 first pass); H54 uses the «بازبینی» (revised, 16:39) section, not the first pass; Batch 7 uses the «توالی نهایی» (confirmed corrected) lists. Grade 1-3 = good, 0 = wrong, 'ambiguous' = human «نامشخص» (excluded from metrics, counted separately). Per-hunt grades stand even when the same token has a different grade in another hunt.
crossCheck: positions match frozen-pool-titles.json exactly on all 1399 (huntId, position) pairs; see frozenTokenNotes for token differences
